title: Democrats' open border nightmare just came crashing down after this national security bombshell
text:
The Biden-Harris administration spent four years claiming the border was secure.
National security experts knew the truth was far more dangerous.
And Democrats’ open border nightmare just came crashing down after this national security bombshell.
Expert warns Chinese illegal crossings pose major threat The full scope of the Biden-Harris administration’s border disaster is finally coming to light.
And it’s even worse than Americans imagined.
A shocking new report reveals that Chinese illegal immigrant crossings exploded during the Biden-Harris years, creating what experts are calling a massive national security threat.
Lora Ries, director of the Heritage Foundation’s Border Security and Immigration Center and former Department of Homeland Security acting deputy chief of staff, didn’t mince words when she spoke to Fox News Digital about the crisis.
The sharp increase in Chinese nationals crossing the southern border is "absolutely" a national security concern, Ries told Fox News Digital.¹
The numbers are staggering and tell the story of a complete border meltdown under the last administration’s watch.
In fiscal year 2024 alone, over 24,376 Chinese nationals were encountered and 24,214 were apprehended according to the House Committee on Homeland Security.²
But here’s the kicker that shows just how badly Biden failed: In March 2024 alone, border encounters of Chinese nationals increased over 8,000% when compared to March 2021.³
That’s not a typo.
An 8,000% increase.
Biden opened floodgates for Chinese Communist Party infiltration The contrast between the Trump and Biden years couldn’t be more stark.
"Pre-Biden, Customs and Border Protection would see about 1,000 Chinese nationals a month nationwide, whether that was at the ports of entry or between ports of entry," Ries explained. "And, during Biden’s four years, that rose rapidly to 2,000, up to 7,000 a month. It even hit over 8,000 one month in December of 2023. And most of these were between the ports of entry," Ries said.⁴
Most troubling of all, these were illegal border crossings, not legal immigration.
Ries fears the Chinese Communist Party was using the southern border as a "tactic" against the United States during Biden’s disastrous tenure.
"Given the many tactics that the Chinese Communist Party uses against the U.S. — whether that is sending fentanyl precursor ingredients to Mexico to be smuggled into the U.S., killing hundreds of thousands of Americans, COVID-19 from Wuhan, spy balloons, buying farmland near military bases — we have to assume that the CCP took advantage of the open border during Biden’s years and sent many Chinese nationals with mal-intent," Ries warned.⁵
Criminal enterprises thrived under Biden’s open borders The consequences of Biden’s failed border policies are already becoming clear.
U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) deported 122 illegal immigrants to China on June 3, many of whom were convicted of murder, drug trafficking, rape and human smuggling.⁶
Officials had to use a "special high risk charter flight" to transport these dangerous criminals back to China.
That’s how serious the threat had become.
The Department of Justice on Tuesday charged seven Chinese nationals in a major marijuana trafficking case.⁷
"This case reveals a sprawling criminal enterprise that exploited our immigration system for personal gain," said U.S. Attorney Leah Foley.⁸
She added that the defendants allegedly built a multimillion-dollar operation using illegal workers.
Trump’s return brings hope for border security The Biden administration’s reckless open border policies didn’t just fail — they put American national security at risk.
While Biden was busy claiming the border was secure, Chinese nationals were pouring across in record numbers.
Many of them likely had connections to the Chinese Communist Party or criminal organizations.
President Donald Trump has already taken decisive action to secure the border and end the chaos that Biden created.
Under Trump’s leadership, America can finally start to address the national security nightmare that Biden left behind.
But the damage has already been done.
Thousands of Chinese nationals are now scattered across the country, and many of them pose a direct threat to American communities.
Biden’s legacy will be one of total border failure and putting American lives at risk for the sake of his radical open borders agenda.
The American people deserve better than a President who sells out their safety to appease the far-Left.
